[SWS_Dem_01287] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067 ⌈If the API Dem_GetMonitorStatus is called, the Dem shall copy the current monitor status into the out parameter MonitorStatus and return E_OK. ⌋ [SWS_Dem_01326] Monitor status initialization Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04031 ⌈The Dem shall initialize the monitor status in the following way: • If Dem_SetEventStatus is called between Dem_PreInit and Dem_Init, the reported monitor status shall be used. • If no monitor status was reported before Dem_Init, the Dem shall use the event status recovered from NvM as the monitor status. ⌋ [SWS_Dem_01419] Monitor status availability Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04031 ⌈If Dem_GetMonitorStatus is called before Dem_Init has initialized the monitor status, the Dem shall return E_NOT_OK. ⌋
